newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms against dollar.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar on Thursday but weakened against sterling, reflecting international market trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial mean rate of 20.461 to the dollar, from 20.491 on Wednesday, and at 33.533 to sterling from 33.433.

Forex dealers said the rupee's price was in line with the dollar weakening on overnight markets. They said there was commercial bank demand for dollars and predicted possible central bank intervention.
